comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling homes to consumers with mortgage and title arms; it buys lots rather than developing them for sale.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Largest homebuilder selling homes to consumers; it is Forestar's majority owner and customer, not a pure lot developer.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Production homebuilder selling to consumers using optioned lots; it is a lot buyer, not a developer.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Develops residential land into finished lots and sells some to third-party builders, though it is mostly a homebuilder.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling to consumers with affiliated mortgage and title; it is a lot consumer, not a developer.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Option-lot homebuilder with a mortgage bank; it buys lots from developers and is not in lot development.
